parameters_and_hyperparameters: mu = 4.65, sigma = 0.32, E[tau] approx 105 min pre-departure
operational_mechanics_and_purpose: Transforms discrete flight schedule pulses into realistic continuous passenger arrival waves peaking 90-120 minutes before takeoff.
Emits true probabilistic prediction intervals rather than rigid scalar point forecasts.
Captures non-linear operational threshold effects (e.g., how prior-hour flight delays suddenly dampen arrivals and create secondary queue backlogs).
